privacy.heroSubtitle: How we protect and handle your personal information.
privacy.intro: At Perhitsiksha (formerly CLSI), we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or interact with our services.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.personalIntro: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us, including:
personalItems: Name, email address, and phone number
Any other information you choose to provide
collect.autoIntro: When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:
autoItems: Pages visited and time spent on our site

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.intro: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
items: Processing donations and managing contributor relationships
Evaluating and processing scholarship applications
Providing updates on student progress and organizational activities
Improving our website and services
Responding to inquiries and providing customer support
Complying with legal obligations
Sending periodic emails about our programs (with your consent)

sharing.title: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.intro: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties, except in the following circumstances:
items: Service Providers: We may share information with trusted third parties who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or serving our users
Legal Requirements: We may disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights and safety
Consent: We may share information with your explicit consent
Student-Contributor Connection: With appropriate consent, we facilitate communication between students and their sponsors while maintaining privacy boundaries

security.title: Data Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information, including:
items: Secure data transmission using encryption technology
Regular security assessments and updates
Restricted access to personal information on a need-to-know basis
Secure storage of financial and personal data
security.note: However, please note that no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

rights.title: Your Rights and Choices
items: Access, update, or delete your personal information
Opt out of marketing communications
Request information about how your data is used
Withdraw consent for data processing (where applicable)
File a complaint with relevant data protection authorities
rights.contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at clsi.perhitsiksha@gmail.com.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: Our website may contain links to third-party websites and services, including:
items: YouTube videos and social media platforms
Payment processing services
Google Analytics for website analytics
thirdParty.note: These third-party services have their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review their privacy practices as we are not responsible for their content or privacy policies.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete such information promptly.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. When we make changes, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this policy. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how we protect your information.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us:
contact.responseNote: We will respond to your inquiries within 30 days.

privacy.footerNote: This privacy policy is effective as of the date stated above and applies to all information collected by Perhitsiksha through our website and services.
